Sales by Shop

How to read this table

1st 2nd 3rd 4th 5th 6th = that bag's top 6 shops
  • Each row is a new bag, each column a shop — the number is how many of that bag the shop sold in the period chosen above.
  • The colours rank the shops within each row: gold is where that bag sells best, then silver, bronze, green, cyan and violet down to its 6th-best shop. Shops on the same number share a place. On the TOTAL row the colours rank the shops across all new bags.
  • Hover (or tap) any number to see which colours that shop sold; hover a row's Total for its colours across all shops.
  • CORP = the Corporate app (bags paid for in the period), ranked like a shop. OTH = any other till, counted in the totals but not ranked. SNZ = Sinza + Dar-es-Salaam; Staff POS is left out. A dimmed 0 means no sales.
  • Posts = Kenya + outside marketing posts for the period (Weekly, Lifetime and Custom show "—": posts are counted a week in arrears and only per week / month).
